Hello Philippe,
Thank you so much for your trust and positive feedback! We're delighted that your experience was completely satisfactory for you and your pet.
Lots of cuddles to your pet!
The veterinary team.

Since the change of ownership, the clinic has really gone downhill:… For vaccinations or general checkups, everything is fine. But for, say, a real digestive problem, they have absolutely no competence! My cat was very poorly treated; basically, I had to manage on my own until the vet finally did some research and approved the treatment.
My cat suffered unnecessarily for three months, and so did I. Just one consultation at Vetin Paris, which I highly recommend, and the problem was solved in two days.

And I'll spare you the details… Error and delay in sending stool samples to the lab, unnecessary and painful cortisone injection, and incompetent, arrogant, and unpleasant receptionists.

I called the clinic where my cat is seen by Dr. Le Moing (an excellent veterinarian), so I had complete confidence in her, and made an emergency appointment on Monday, August 5th.

My cat was seen on Wednesday the 8th by Dr. Rivière (a substitute), so I was very disappointed. I didn't feel any connection or rapport with the animal. The diagnosis: advanced feline herpesvirus (FHV-1) in the eye. She prescribed eye drops only, without any painkillers or anti-inflammatories, and didn't even examine my cat. I insisted, emphasizing that my pet was in pain and that I was surprised by the simple prescription.

She replied, "Bring him back in two days, Friday, to check on his progress..." The next day, Thursday, my Friday appointment was canceled, even though he absolutely had to be seen. The appointment was rescheduled for Monday, August 10th.
My pet's condition worsened in the meantime; his second eye was infected, he stopped eating, he cried, and he slept. Distraught, I called on Saturday at 6 pm for advice and was told to take him to the emergency room.
The response I received, verbatim: "These days we don't have any ophthalmic treatments available at the clinic, and this is an emergency because it could be an eye ulcer." I was stunned, especially coming from a cat clinic... I remind you that my cat was supposed to be seen again on Friday.

Finally, on Monday the 10th in the morning, I was able to bring my pet in as an emergency.
A thorough 40-minute examination and blood test... My cat was howling in pain with both eyes infected and closed, a fever of 40°C (104°F), and he wasn't eating. The diagnosis: severe feline herpesvirus (FHV-1). He was prescribed a 20-day intensive treatment with anti-inflammatories, painkillers, and antibiotics, and this time, a proper follow-up appointment. My cat suffered for five days due to negligence, incompetence, or lack of experience on the part of this very young doctor who didn't listen to us when I told her he was in pain.

Dear Dr. Rivière, this is very serious. You have neither my apologies nor our forgiveness. Even if you are only a substitute, be more dedicated and attentive, because you hold the lives of our beloved animals in your hands, and I hope there will be no consequences... believe me... This was very poor care, especially with veterinarians absent and not replaced, and appointments canceled because only one vet was present. There are much better ways to organize things. As for me, I'm leaving you. It's a shame for Dr. Le Moing, but you no longer have my trust.

A rating to conclude my review: 2/20...

I've been taking my two cats to these vets for several years now, and they are truly kind and professional, very attentive to both owners and animals.

During consultations, they take the time to ask about medical history, etc.

I highly recommend them.

Hello 😊 Thank you so much for your trust and positive feedback!

Best regards,
The veterinary team. …

I recently took my cat to this veterinary clinic and the experience was very positive! My cat was seen promptly. The team is welcoming, professional, and very caring. Dr. Le Moing examined my cat very carefully and took the time to answer all my questions clearly.

Hello 🤗
Thank you so much for your trust and positive feedback!
Lots of cuddles to your pet!
The veterinary team. …

I was seen as an emergency vet for my cat who was vomiting excessively. The vet quickly understood that the vomiting was related to an inability to urinate and was able to diagnose the seriousness of the situation.
The care was exemplary: responsiveness, clear explanations; the surgery went well, and the follow-up was attentive and reassuring.
A huge thank you to Dr. Le Moing for his professionalism and support during such a distressing time.

I was very disappointed with the reception. My cat has been seen every year for almost 14 years. This morning when I woke up, he was lethargic, not moving, not eating, and didn't respond when called. At 9:00 AM, I called, very worried about his condition. The receptionist, after consulting with the veterinarian, refused to see me because there were no available appointments. There was no possibility of an emergency appointment; I was referred to a clinic that only offered weekend hospitalization. Very disappointed, I contacted a clinic in the 7th arrondissement of Paris. I was seen at 10:00 AM. After a thorough examination and consultation, it was diagnosed as a severe case of cystitis. I left two hours later with a prescription for antibiotics and without hospitalization. Thank you to the cat clinic for your professionalism and all your attention to a cat you've been treating since birth. For the first time he was sick, well done! We can count on you!!!

My cat suffered a lot. I spent two months going back and forth to the clinic for this or that, buying medication, and they changed his food several times. My cat left that clinic with severe pancreatitis, and the staff sent me elsewhere because they couldn't do anything else... My cat was finally treated and cured in 10 days at another clinic.

Exemplary professionalism, a warm welcome, and, unusually, these attentive veterinarians take all the time necessary to ensure a thorough consultation. Outstanding follow-up and invaluable advice. Highly recommended.
Alright

I've known this clinic for 10 years.
Dr. Lemoing took care of my cats with professionalism.
His colleague took over for my cat's end-of-life care; she was gentle, attentive, and clear.
The veterinary assistants are also available and offer excellent advice.
Thank you to the entire team for their patience and support.

The receptionist's attitude is unacceptable. I don't understand how anyone can work in a veterinary clinic with so little empathy and so much contempt for clients.

I called because my cat's condition had worsened since the consultation, and I wanted to know if further treatment was needed. As soon as I gave my last name, she told me she couldn't find anything, then started questioning me, accusing me of having the wrong name… and even of having the wrong veterinarian. Yet, I've been there several times this week.

Her tone was curt, bordering on hostile. She was clearly ready to hang up without even asking why I was calling or what was wrong with my cat. No effort to look elsewhere, no kindness whatsoever. I had to insist that she search using my pet's name. She finally said that "the system glitches when names are too short," which seems to be a common occurrence, but there was no apology, no patience.

During my last visit, their payment system wasn't working either—I had to come back a second time just to pay. They're aware of their technical issues, and yet they treat you as if you were the problem.

And to top it all off, she criticized me for not having my cat examined more thoroughly, even though that was precisely why I called. When I explained that no recommendations were made during the consultation, she snapped at me: "How would I know? Some cats get better after a few days."

I came across several other negative reviews about this receptionist, and I understand why. If speaking properly to people and showing even a basic interest in animals costs you this much, you should find another line of work.

Fortunately, Dr. Cohen was very gentle and professional with my cat. It's a shame that the reception so negatively impacts the clinic's image.

An exemplary clinic!
The veterinarians and assistants provide exceptional professionalism and care for our beloved pets.

I highly recommend them!
My cat has seen Dr. Lemoing several times, and he has always been incredibly gentle and a great listener. I wouldn't take my cat anywhere else for anything.
I recommend

AVOID AT ALL COSTS! My cat was dying, and they told me to calm down and that what was wrong wasn't serious. He died a few hours later. I learned at another clinic that he had many health problems, whereas six months earlier at this clinic, they had told me he was perfectly healthy. Because of them, my cat died because we couldn't treat him in time.

Thank you again for your magic touch which allowed you to remove a large foxtail deep in my little cocker's ear…your professionalism and the follow-up after the procedure, especially your phone call to check on my dog's health.

Very disappointed.

This Saturday, May 24th, at 6:57 PM, I called the clinic with a simple question: the price for microchipping and neutering my four cats. Yes, four cats, not just one.

The receptionist said hello, then immediately cut me off to say:

"We're closed, call back on Monday for the prices, I'm doing the accounting." All this in a curt tone, as if my request was inconvenient, even though I was asking a clear question that takes 30 seconds at most.

I calmly replied that it wasn't a complicated request.

But clearly, listening and customer service aren't among her priorities here.

And yet… this is a clinic specializing exclusively in cats.

That's precisely why I chose them.
It was important for me to have a clear price so I could plan for these necessary treatments.

And let's be honest: four microchippings and four neuterings is no small matter.

They lost a veterinary procedure on four animals at once.

So yes, it's a shame, and I sincerely believe that a little more listening would have made all the difference.

I have many friends who also have cats.

And they all look for serious, competent professionals with a friendly welcome and a helpful receptionist.

I will not recommend this clinic. And frankly, it's regrettable, because I was really ready to trust them.

And finally: when you answer the phone at 6:57 p.m., it means they're not closed yet.

If they were truly closed, they wouldn't answer the phone.

I'm disgusted, truly disappointed.

And here, you just get the impression that internal organization takes precedence over the animals, and that financial gain ultimately prevails.

I will also publish a screenshot of the exact time of my call (6:57 PM), so that there is no ambiguity.

Friendly vets.
Good experience so far.

Excellent clinic where my cat has been treated for over 10 years.
Professional, attentive, clear diagnosis and treatment...
🙏 …
Very good. Very detailed and not too expensive.

Laetitia has been taking wonderful care of my two cats for years. She knows exactly how to care for them when needed, she's attentive, empathetic, and highly professional, and I really want to thank the entire reception team who are always so accommodating with appointments.

Top-notch team!

Visiting from abroad and had to do a blood and surgical appointment for our pet. The vet accommodated us as soon as possible and provided very kind and knowledgeable care for our cat. So happy we found this vet, thank you Dr. Gillot!
The vets are attentive and very empathetic; everything is available on-site for X-rays and ultrasounds. I highly recommend them.

Laetitia provided vaccinations, surgeries, tooth extractions, and other care for 15 years. She supported me through the end of my Tigrounette's life with such professionalism. I thank the entire team, who are wonderful.
The clinic is very clean, not to mention the doctors who were kind to my cat.
A very pleasant and caring veterinarian who is very attentive to animals! He gives excellent advice.
Excellent team. Our little one had her vaccinations and surgery with this team and everything went very well. They are very professional and kind. I recommend them 100%.

Extremely stressed about my 16-year-old dog, Briochette, after a rushed move without her health record.

A gentle and patient vet who started from scratch and worked step by step to help with the situation.

I highly recommend him.
